chunks: So, when Our messengers came to Lot, he was worried on their account as he was unable to protect them. They said: "Have no fear or regret. We will certainly save you and your family except your wife, for she is one of those who will stay behind."
ai.seo_question: Who was excluded from Prophet Lot's family salvation according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the psychological burden of Prophet Lot (AS) as he balanced his duty of hospitality with the impending divine punishment, illustrating the concept of *al-ghabirin* (those who remain behind in the destruction). The specific exclusion of his wife highlights that familial ties do not guarantee salvation without individual faith and adherence to the divine message.
